doubts.claim_under_doubt: Same-street house-number edit never reached the form (4 -> 6 left 4 on the invoice)
doubts.resolution: fixed: keep branch always reports the rebuilt address with postcode/town; StreetLookup test 'passes a changed house number on to the form'

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Parser comma fix let a typed number override the clicked suggestion's number
doubts.resolution: fixed: a single-building suggestion's own number wins; test 'uses the house number of the clicked suggestion over a different typed one'

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Print/save could use a PDF generated before the municipality was corrected
doubts.resolution: fixed: Index clears pdfData on municipality or address change; e2e asserts preview disappears after re-selecting

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Up to <5 % of a pre-selected locality may belong to another municipality without a hint (e.g. 6315 Alosen)
doubts.resolution: accepted: spec's 80 %/5 % rule chosen by the product owner (pre-select + let her correct); recorded in ADR

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Out-of-canton localities (Bennau, Sattel, Rothenthurm, Mühlau) are accepted with only a hint once step 2 changes suggestion filtering
doubts.resolution: deferred to step 2: triage card filed; today unreachable because suggestions are filtered to Zug postcodes
